row.name: assignments_late_deduction_check
row.value: (late_policy = 'deduct') = (late_deduction_percent is not null) and (late_deduction_percent is null or late_deduction_percent between 1 and 100)

row.name: assignments_rubric_check
row.value: rubric is null or (jsonb_typeof(rubric) = 'object' and octet_length(rubric::text) <= 65536)

row.name: assignments_dates_check
row.value: (available_from is null or due_at is null or due_at >= available_from) and (due_at is null or closes_at is null or closes_at >= due_at) and (available_from is null or closes_at is null or closes_at >= available_from)

row.name: assignments_published_check
row.value: state = 'draft' or published_at is not null

row.name: period_grades_score_check
row.value: score is null or (score >= 0 and score <= max_score)
